Play: Advance the particles and keep adding strokes. Off freezes the current exposure.
Reset: Pulse: clear the particles and the exposure buffer and start again.
Speed: Multiplier on particle step length. 0 = still, higher = longer, faster strokes.
Compose: over: strokes over a dimmed input. add: strokes added on top of the input. bg: strokes on Bgcolor only.
Inputdim: Brightness of the input under the strokes in over mode (0 = hidden, 1 = full).
Bgcolor: Background colour used when Compose is bg.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Fieldmode: How in1 defines flow direction. contour: along edges (perpendicular to the luminance gradient). gradient: along the gradient. luma: angle from luminance. hue: angle from hue.
Inputamt: How strongly the image steers the flow versus noise. Also scales gradient strength and the angle range in luma/hue modes.
Smooth: Gradient sampling distance in pixels (min 0.5). Larger = broader, smoother flow, ignoring fine detail.
Rotate: Rotates the whole flow field, in degrees.
Fieldscale: Spatial frequency of the curl noise field. Higher = tighter swirls.
Fieldspeed: How fast the noise field evolves, in noise units per second. 0 = static.
Turbulence: Amount of curl noise blended into the field (0-1+). Also moves particles through flat image areas.
Speedbymag: 0 = constant speed everywhere. 1 = particles slow down where the field is weak (flat areas).
Count: Number of particles (strokes). More = denser image but heavier on the GPU.
Stepsize: Distance a particle moves per frame, as a fraction of image height (before Speed).
Lifetime: Particle life in frames before it respawns at a random position.
Linewidth: Stroke thickness in pixels (at output height).
Trail: Length of each stroke segment in steps. Longer = streakier lines.
Intensity: Brightness added to the exposure per frame by new strokes.
Exposure: Tone-mapping gain on the accumulated strokes. Higher = brighter, more saturated coverage.
Fade: Exposure decay per frame (0-1). Closer to 1 = longer exposure and longer trails; lower fades fast.
Colormode: Stroke colour source. image: colour of the input. direction: palette by flow angle. age: palette by particle age. line: Linecolor.
Saturation: Image colour saturation of the strokes in image mode. 1 = unchanged, 0 = grey.
Linecolor: Stroke colour when Colormode is line.
